title: Blade Surge: Hack & Slash RPG
shortDescription: Pull the horde in and sweep it away in one blow. 3D action RPG, five heroes.
fullDescription:
Pull in the horde. Sweep it away in one blow.
Blade Surge is a landscape 3D hack-and-slash action RPG with five heroes.

■ The thrill of crowd sweeping
• Vacuum skills drag packs of enemies together so you can wipe them out at once
• Every hero has a 5-6 hit combo, a dodge, three skills and an ultimate
• Time your dodge right and the action slows down to let you turn the fight around
• Too busy to tap? Hand the fight over to AUTO battle
• Awakening skills unlock as you level up, each with its own new move

■ Five heroes, five playstyles
• Arca the Swordsaint: sword and shield, heir of the holy blade
• Drakan the Berserker: tears up the battlefield with a huge axe
• Ria the Archmage: rains starlight magic from a distance
• Kain the Assassin: dual daggers and shadow techniques
• Silva the Windtracker: a forest sharpshooter with a bow
• Pick a hero card and your active hero and save change together

■ Dungeon by dungeon
• 20 dungeons, including Glass Garden, Ember Vault, Starlight Archive and the Eclipse Abyss Gate
• Standard and deeper expeditions, with different bosses and terrain in every dungeon
• Cleanse the zones one by one on the minimap to break the boss seal
• A campaign story that runs through six chapters
• Your companion Neve fights beside you

■ Collect gear and grow stronger
• Collect weapons, armor, rings and boots from drops, and match set bonuses
• Change your gear and your hero's look changes with it
• Enhancement, the crafting workshop, the skill tree and transcendence let you grow step by step
• After each fight, the result screen shows the gear and materials you earned

■ Good to know
• An internet connection is required to play.
• This app may contain ads. Interstitial ads are shown only when you choose them from the 'Ads · Restore purchases' menu in the lobby.
• Includes random items (paid summons for heroes and gear). Rates and pity rules are shown in the in-game rate information and at blade.tllhouse.com/odds.html.
• The game is built for landscape orientation. Please rotate your device.
• Support: blade.tllhouse.com
